input.quote: Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: Section 20 meets our preferred position: Vendor IP indemnity covering Customer and its Affiliates, plus indemnities for breach of law, bodily injury/property damage, Customer Data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct; standard notice/cooperation/control procedure; procure-modify-replace-refund remedies; and a narrow Customer indemnity limited to unmodified Customer material and Customer's own violation of law. Indemnities also sit outside the liability cap as Excluded Claims (21.3).

input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory.
input.rationale: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds Customer; Section 12.3 expressly confirms the point. The only competitive restraint (12.4) binds Vendor, which benefits us and is not flagged.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation is imposed on us; Section 2.1 confirms we pay only for Services ordered and Section 12.3 expressly preserves our right to engage any supplier.
